title: 857. Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K

examples.explanation: The whole array sums to 1 with length 1.

hints: Prefix sums turn any segment sum into a difference of two prefixes; the task becomes finding close indices with a large enough rise.
Keep candidate start positions in a deque ordered by increasing prefix value, discarding dominated entries to preserve monotonicity.
For each new prefix, pop from the front while the window already reaches `k` to record the shortest length, then maintain the monotonic order at the back.
